The next reference diagnostic varies numerical resolution at the same saved
states. Separate basis, quadrature and high-wavenumber ladders retain the original
settings as controls; two combined levels check whether the refinements interact.
Both backends keep their own signed species outputs at every level.

| preparation evidence | result |
|---|---|
| synthetic protocol and output checks | [40 focused synthetic checks pass in each mode after the input-path correction, covering signed channels, refinement identities, baseline drift, incomplete evidence and existing diagnostic output handling]{.claim}[C-202](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-202){.cid .st-tested} |
| physical convergence or temperature acceptance | not established by preparation |

Reporting preserves the full observed flux range and the changes between
successive levels. Those quantities measure numerical sensitivity; they are not
certified error bounds or confidence intervals. The selected wavenumber control
leaves the low-wavenumber nodes unchanged, so the study cannot certify full
spectral convergence. It also leaves mode count and width-search resolution fixed.

The first submission failed during preflight, before any physical solver call.
Moving to a different working directory exposed two relative evidence paths.
The controller now resolves those paths before freezing the package. A separate
preparation attempt encountered the requested project's storage quota; the owner
approved alternate shared-work storage for this diagnostic. Both failures remain
recorded, and the corrected package must pass verification from its actual run
directory before another submission.

The current model, guard and temperature criterion remain fixed. Reference
admissibility depends on the numerical results and a subsequent reviewed energy
treatment. The separate feedback-sampling proposal is still unapproved.

**What's next.** Execute and audit the bounded refinement study, retaining every
disagreement and unresolved resolution limit before choosing further reference work.
No external artifact synchronization occurs.
